name: @hyperscape/physx-js-webidl
description: Node.js-compatible Javascript/WASM bindings for Nvidia PhysX 5.6.0
author: fabmax

scripts.prebuild: mkdir -p dist && cp types/physx-js-webidl.d.ts dist/ && ( [ -f dist/physx-js-webidl.js ] && [ -f dist/physx-js-webidl.wasm ] && echo 'PhysX already built, skipping...' || ( [ -f ../client/src/public/physx-js-webidl.js ] && [ -f ../client/src/public/physx-js-webidl.wasm ] && cp ../client/src/public/physx-js-webidl.js dist/ && cp ../client/src/public/physx-js-webidl.wasm dist/ && echo 'Copied prebuilt PhysX files from client/public' || echo 'PhysX binaries not built - types only mode' ) )
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp types/physx-js-webidl.d.ts dist/ && ( [ -f dist/physx-js-webidl.js ] && [ -f dist/physx-js-webidl.wasm ] && echo 'PhysX already built, skipping...' || bash ./make.sh )
scripts.test: echo 'No tests for PhysX bindings package'
